question: UR.SOURCE.LOWQ.01: Rekonstruieren globale Operatorantworten, volle irreduzible Fockdarstellung und globale uniforme Semibeschraenktheit den stabilen Generator bereits aus Q<=4, und sind seine Quelljets tatsaechlich aus P1/P2 hergeleitet?
assumptions: full irreducible Fock representation generated by the tested finite CAR and CCR fields
self-adjoint H strongly commuting with Q=N_f+2N_b on a common invariant algebraic finite-particle core
global lower fermion and boson operator responses with hermitian matrices h and Omega
one uniform lower energy bound on the complete Fock space
resolved: global semiboundedness eliminates every pure conversion order m>=3 in the classified hierarchy
the full remaining stable class is determined by Q<=4 blocks C1 and C2 together with c, h and Omega
D4 equals the filled-state defect D_F in the m<=2 class
the native identities Xdagger X F=480F and Xdagger X^2 F=916XF hold exactly
det(sum_A Q_A)=5^32 proves X^mF nonzero for m=0,...,32 and native Krylov dimension at least 33
for matrix kinetics the moment invariant is 349/120 plus the exact nonnegative kinetic variance term
kills: global stability alone forces the direct double-conversion coefficient C2 to vanish
the scalar value 349/120 remains universal under arbitrary hermitian h and Omega
semigroup positivity or temporal reflection positivity selects the primitive native event support
low-sector checks can replace the global operator-response hypotheses
not_derived: actual primitive-source jets C1 and C2
source-derived h, Omega and nonzero g on one common field space
physical time and state from P1/P2
summary_de: Unter den globalen Fock-, Operatorantwort- und Semibeschraenktheitsannahmen ist der stabile Generator aus Q<=4 bedingt rekonstruierbar. Die tatsaechlichen Quelljets, h, Omega, g, Zeit und Zustand sind nicht aus P1/P2 hergeleitet; alle physischen Gates bleiben offen.
